primitives.name: Team Market Strength Prior
primitives.verbatim_quote: Join team market strength to player opportunity so prop projections inherit a game-level prior.
primitives.latex: \text{Prop Projection} \sim P(\text{Player Outcome}|\text{Game Context}) \propto P(\text{Player Outcome}|\text{Opponent Shell Mix}) \times P(\text{Market Strength})
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(\\text{Player Outcome}|\\text{Opponent Shell Mix})': 'Dimensionless conditional probability of player outcome given opponent defensive alignment', 'P(\\text{Market Strength})': 'Dimensionless prior distribution capturing betting market pressure and team resource allocation'}
primitives.assumptions: Bayesian exchangeability across similar game contexts; linear superposition of market signals and charting features; no omitted variable bias from hidden team dynamics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-frequency market shocks (e.g., injury reports) that decouple historical correlation between shell mix and player performance.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Prop bet calibration as posterior mean update. GSE: Situational awareness fusion via belief-state transition matrices.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error reduction in player-targeted prop lines after incorporating opponent shell mix features.

primitives.name: EPA/WPA Facet Separation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Use EPA/WPA facet decomposition to separate "won by passing" from "won by turnovers" before carrying form forward.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\Delta EP{{A}_{t}}': 'Net Expected Points Added at time t (units: points)', 'EP{{A}_{i,t}}': 'Expected Points Added for event i at time t (points)', '\\Delta EP{{A}_{pass,t}}': 'Faceted contribution from passing plays only (points)', '\\Delta EP{{A}_{turnover,t}}': 'Faceted contribution from turnovers only (points)'}
primitives.assumptions: Stationary parameter regime within the documented observation horizon; zero missing covariates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Structural shifts in playcalling frequency that alter the covariance between passing and turnover risk.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Rolling form models use separated facets as independent state variables. GSE: Situational reasoning tracks distinct causal pathways separately.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in residual variance when regressing future QB WPA against lagged facet-specific EPA components.

primitives.name: Shell-Mix Conditioning
primitives.verbatim_quote: Condition receiver opportunity on opponent shell mix, then preserve uncertainty when the charting feed is unavailable.
primitives.latex: P(\text{Target Opportunity} | \text{Shell Mix}) = f(\text{Shell Mix}, \theta) \quad \text{with } \theta \sim Q(\cdot)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(\\text{Target Opportunity} | \\text{Shell Mix})': 'Conditional probability of receiver target opportunities given defensive shell configuration', 'f(\\text{Shell Mix}, \\theta)': 'Parametric link function with parameters \\theta drawn from variational posterior Q'}
primitives.assumptions: Stationary parameter regime within the documented observation horizon; zero missing covariates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Out-of-distribution shell configurations (e.g., exotic nickel packages) where training data is sparse.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Uncertainty quantification via ensemble Kalman filtering. GSE: State estimation with particle filters over shell-feature subspaces.
layer2.telemetry: Negative log-likelihood of observed target opportunities under predictive posterior distribution.
